name: nvidia-tao-toolkit
description: NVIDIA TAO skill bank with generated capability discovery for model training, data processing, application workflows, AutoML, and platform execution.

interface.longDescription: Agent skills for NVIDIA TAO: fine-tune, evaluate, export, and deploy vision and multimodal models; prepare and generate training data; run AutoML and application workflows; and launch jobs on Docker, Kubernetes, SLURM, or Brev. The plugin exposes every skill under ./skills/. Capability answers are generated from the packaged skills by scripts/list_tao_capabilities.py rather than hard-coded in plugin metadata.
defaultPrompt: Choose and run a TAO workflow for my dataset.
List TAO models, actions, AutoML, and platforms.
